Claim 1 (Currently Amended): A combination product comprising: (A) BH4, a functional derivative selected from the group consisting of a pyrazinopyrimidone ring system or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative of BH4, its functional derivative, or its precursor; and (B) an inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of angiotensin II (AII), or a specific known pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative thereof, wherein each of components (A) and (B) is formulated in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier.

Claim 2 (Currently Amended): A combination product as claimed in Claim 1 that comprises a pharmaceutical formulation including BH4, a functional derivative selected from the group consisting of a pyrazinopyrimidone ring system or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative of BH4, its functional derivative, or its precursor, an inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of angiotensin II (AII), or a specific known pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative thereof, and a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier.

Claim 3 (Currently Amended): A combination product as claimed in Claim 1 that comprises a kit of parts comprising components: (I) a pharmaceutical formulation including BH4, a functional derivative selected from the group consisting of a pyrazinopyrimidone ring system or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative of BH4, its functional derivative, or its precursor, in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier; and (II) a pharmaceutical formulation including an inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of angiotensin II (AII), or a specific known pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative thereof, in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier, which components (I) and (II) are each provided in a form that is suitable for administration in conjunction with the other.

Claim 17 (Currently Amended): A kit of parts comprising: (1) one of components (I) and (II), as defined in any one of Claims 3 to 15; together with (2) instructions to use that component in conjunction with the other of the two components, wherein the terms “functional derivative” and “angiontensin II (AII)” are defined as detailed in the specification.
